properties.description:
Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 linked service for the Silver container (evdatalakedev2).

Authentication : System-assigned Managed Identity of the ADF instance.
Used by        : ds_silver_blob_sink — blob file migration into the silver container.

NOTE: If your ADF already has an ADLS Gen2 linked service pointing to
evdatalakedev2 (e.g. ls_adls_ev or ls_adls_gen2), reuse that one in
ds_silver_blob_sink instead of creating a new linked service.
